issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement's UML declares the method as public (+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int) (problem_statement.md line 70), but the solution implementation declares it as protected (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). This difference in access level can confuse students: the UML and task text imply the method is publicly callable, while a protected implementation restricts access from outside the package/subclasses and may cause examples or tests that call the method from other classes to fail or be misleading. The template file currently contains a TODO for this method (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 12), so students will follow the UML description unless the UML is corrected.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the visibility consistent. Preferred fix: change the solution implementation signature to public by updating solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75 from
    protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()
to
    public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()
so it matches the UML and the task description. Alternatively, if the method is intentionally meant to be protected, update the UML and problem text (problem_statement.md line 70) to indicate protected visibility and mention that the method is not part of the public API.
